short: We're a small, close-knit chiropractic practice built around one-on-one care. Rather than a high-volume, in-and-out model, we take the time to really listen to our patients and understand what's going on before we treat it. Our approach is hands-on and personalized, focused on helping people find real relief from common issues like headaches, sciatica, low back pain, and indigestion — all within the scope of chiropractic care. We pride ourselves on being approachable and attentive, so patients feel heard, not rushed.
training: Doctor of Chiropractic (D.C.), Palmer College of Chiropractic, Davenport Campus — graduated 2014.
pricing:

long: Ours is a small, intimate office  — designed around true one-on-one care. We currently offer chiropractic adjustments along with stretching to support treatment, without the distraction of a large facility or a revolving door of patients. We're a growing practice, and while we don't yet offer additional modalities, we plan to expand our services in the coming months to years as the practice grows.
size: Currently, I run two offices solo, working six days a week and seeing approximately 20–25 patients per day. I'm at personal capacity and actively working toward building out my team so I can extend availability to more patients without sacrificing the quality of one-on-one care. My goal over the next months to years is sustainable growth — bringing on additional providers or support staff so the practice can serve more people without me being the sole point of care for every visit.
